Iacocca: An Autobiography is Lee Iacocca 's best selling autobiography , co-authored with William Novak and originally published in 1984. Most of the book is taken up with reminiscences of Iacocca's career in the car industry, first with the Ford Motor Company , then the Chrysler Corporation . The hugely successful autobiography was the best-selling non-fiction hardcover book of 1984 and 1985.

Description

Lido Anthony Iacocca, commonly known as Lee Iacocca (b. October 15, 1924, Allentown, Pennsylvania- d. July 2, 2019, Los Angeles, California) was an automobile executive who had been president of Ford Motors and president and CEO of the Chrysler Corporation. His career began in August 1946 as an engineer with Ford Motors, and years later he would become President of the company from December 10, 1970 to July 13, 1978. Upon leaving Ford, he went to work for the Chrysler Corporation and managed to save the company from bankruptcy in 1979 by receiving a loan guaranteed from US Congress, and was able to pay off the loan in 1986.
